name: onlinereaderframework
description: A React reader framework for publishing a book as a readable, searchable, accessible web edition.
author: Dominik Lukeš

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix packages/reader-core --ignore-scripts --min-release-age=7 && npm ci --prefix examples/reader-example --ignore-scripts --min-release-age=7
scripts.test: npm run test:publication-content --prefix packages/reader-core && npm run test:agent-export --prefix packages/reader-core && node packages/reader-core/src/embed/test-embed.mjs && node --test packages/reader-core/src/original/test-original-reader.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/test-outline-preference.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/reading-support/test-reading-preferences.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/toolbar/test-toolbar-model.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/test-reader-theme.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/listening/test-reader-listening.mjs packages/reader-core/src/original/read-aloud/test-read-aloud.mjs
